## Summary of Changes
Provide a brief summary of the proposed changes, motivation, and context.

## Related Backlog Items / Issues
- Closes # (or correlates to Backlog item B-xx / Official Task xx)

## Type of Change
- [ ] `feat`: New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `chore`: Build system, configuration, or dependency updates
- [ ] `test`: Unit, integration, or Selenium test additions
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD pipeline, Jenkinsfile, or deployment configuration

## Quality Gate Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's visual design guidelines (handwritten CSS, no frameworks, approved palette).
- [ ] Java 17 / Jakarta EE 10 compliance maintained (`jakarta.*` only, no `javax.*`).
- [ ] Local build passes: `mvn.cmd clean package` generates valid `target/legal-diary.war`.
- [ ] All automated unit / integration tests pass locally.
- [ ] No credentials, passwords, or secrets committed in code or configuration.
- [ ] PR targets the `develop` branch (not `main`).
- [ ] Detailed verification notes and viva explanation added to `PROGRESS.md`.
